details:
Reproduce steps:
1. Use a station to sit.
2. Open quick menu and go to another world while sitting.
3. Then, another player (not using station) is suddenly moved to that station location.

Tested client version: 2018.1.3.

Notes:
- It seems 100% reproducible.
- Shutting down client also reproduce this issue.
- Movement of another player is sometimes done in "incomplete" way especially in Y-axis. The avatar location and view point (= player camera location) might be separated.
title: When a player using VRC_Station exits from a world, another player is moved to that station
